description: Where a new session starts (ADR-0190 D3-c 증보 2026-10-01, #2775): pick a folder with the native dialog, re-check a remembered folder, and create one git worktree under ~/.oort/worktrees. For the main window's own webview (label `main`) on the bundled (local) origin only, scoped by webview like git-read.json so a child webview does not inherit it. No `remote` entry, and no `dialog:*` permission: the webview cannot open the dialog plugin itself.
